thread:
maria: Heads-up - I'm landing a small TF module refactor that moves the k8s ServiceAccount binding into a dedicated module. It changes provider usage (introduces an aliased kubernetes provider) and adds a sa_binding output. Need a quick check on provider pinning + lockfile regen before I merge.
alex: Thanks. Quick plan: add explicit provider versions in the module + root required_providers, run a lockfile regen in root, and push the lockfile. Do we need to alias providers for cross-cluster usage? @sam any GKE-specific gotchas?
sam: Quick Q: this refactor shouldn't touch GCP IAM attachments, right? We only move the RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding stuff. Also for prod we use a registry mirror for provider plugins — we'll need to update that after lockfile changes.
jess: I can run a staging smoke plan. Which workspace/vars do you want me to use? And tag the PR so I can canary it.
alex: Plan for pins: add required_providers to the module and root e.g.
```terraform
required_providers {
  kubernetes = {
    source = "hashicorp/kubernetes"
    version = "~> 2.11"
  }
}
provider "kubernetes" {
  alias = "alpha"
}
```
Then in module calls use `provider = kubernetes.alpha` where needed.
maria: Also we need to expose the KMS/secret path as an input to the module. Current secret path used by the service is `secret/data/platform/service-accounts/sa-key` — I'll add `kms_secret_path` var and keep the current path as default.
sam: On lockfile: after pins run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` in the repo root and commit `.terraform.lock.hcl`. I'll then update the mirror (internal registry) with the new provider artifacts. I'll open a tiny PR for the mirror sync.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: plan started for workspace `staging` by jess — running provider/version checks and module integrity scans.
jess: Plan finished for staging. No resource replacements expected; only rolebindings added. Snippet from plan:
```
+ kubernetes_role_binding.platform_sa (resource additions)
  - will add rolebinding to namespace `platform`
```
No GCP IAM role changes.
alex: To avoid any service impact: canary apply to staging, then prod apply with `-target=module.sa_binding` if staging looks good. Rollback plan: keep a quick `terraform state rm` + reapply previous state snapshot in case we need to revert rolebinding changes. Thoughts?
maria: Good call. I'll hold the refactor PR until `.terraform.lock.hcl` commit is merged. I'll also add a CI `compat_test` job that runs `terraform init -lockfile=readonly` and `terraform plan -detailed-exitcode`.
sam: LGTM. I'll push lockfile changes to the mirror and tag the mirror PR. @jess ping me if the staging plan complains about provider mismatches.
jess: Will do — plan looked clean on my end. Merging after lockfile PR lands and we validate canary. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
